name: FlashDrive
long_description:
Our mission is to rebuild the file system, the oldest idea in computing, for its newest users: AI agents.

FlashDrive is a shared drive for teams and their AI agents. You can use it via MCP or mount it like a normal folder on macOS and Linux, so your laptop, your teammates' and every sandbox work in the same live files at once. Agents hand off work through files: one writes, the next one reads.

That makes AI multiplayer across a whole company. Everyone keeps the agent they already like, whether that's Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or something custom, and there's no new app to learn. Your agents and your teammates' agents work in the same files and pick up where each other left off.

Shared drives were built for people. Agents work differently: many of them edit the same files at once. Unlike Dropbox or Google Drive, FlashDrive merges edits made at the same time, or keeps both, instead of creating a conflicted copy. Cloud sandboxes connect with no setup, huge files stream instead of filling the disk, and every file can be searched with keywords and grep.

(FlashDrive is by Evokoa, Inc.)
one_liner: A shared drive for your team and all your AI agents.
